experiment: In vitro: PLGA-IL-10 catheter in aCSF, 30 days. Measure IL-10 (ELISA) + glycan (SPR).
pass_rule: IL-10 >= 0.1 ng/cm²/day at day 30 AND glycan >= 10^12/cm² AND total < 10 µmol/cm² (toxicity)
fail_rule: IL-10 < 0.1 at day 30 OR toxicity exceeded
ambiguous_rule: CI spans pass/fail threshold → AMBIGUOUS (no silent promotion)
